recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: aftershocks still rippling through northern coastlines
international rescue teams converging on fractured cities
San Francisco fog lifting into a mostly clear summer morning
long daylight stretching past eight-thirty tonight
cargo lanes quiet under a pale Pacific horizon

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap in the micro-gaps between stuttering kick drums as a scrolling waveform plays; each clean hit brightens the drop, each miss glitches the bass louder.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: nailing one 45-second drop feels like unlocking a Fred again.. breakdown live.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM doubles every 15 seconds and ghost notes appear between real hits
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon waveform on spinning black vinyl

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick supply crates across crumbling lanes toward outstretched hands before aftershocks collapse the bridges between them.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: clearing a full convoy in under a minute feels like a rescue sprint against the clock.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: aftershocks widen lane gaps and add spinning debris mid-air
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: paper cutout relief maps with trembling edges

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw sun paths through rolling fog banks to reach rooftop gardens; fog thickens and erases lines that wander too long.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: one clean sunbeam reaching a terrace triggers a burst of summer bloom.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: wind shears your drawn line mid-stroke and spawns new fog banks
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor fog gradients over muted SF rooftops

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Swipe between three pastel lanes collecting vinyl fragments that match the chorus hook; wrong lane mutes the melody until you recover.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: stacking a full chorus in 60 seconds as Swedish pop swells into clarity.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: lanes merge, split, and invert color-matching rules every 20 seconds
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: pastel Scandinavian album sleeves floating in summer light
